description: Per-room ESP32-C5 WiFi probe fleet: fleet verdict strip, reachability SLA (gateway/DNS/internet/HTTPS), link quality (RSSI/channel/BSSID), device health, and per-room AP survey. Rooms come from the scrape-time `room` label. Generated by scripts/grafana/build_wifi_probes_overview.py.

panels.description: Fraction of rooms whose probe data is FRESH — uptime advanced within $window. Cutover-agnostic: holds whether Prometheus scrapes probes directly or via the OTLP collector cache (which serves the last push for 30m). sum-of-bool numerator (not count) so it never vanishes at a total outage; or vector(0) keeps an empty fleet at a clear 0 instead of No data.
panels.title: 📡 Probes Reporting

panels.description: Distinct rooms reporting probe data. Green at ≥1 so a single-room (or $room-filtered) deployment isn't falsely degraded.
panels.title: 🏠 Rooms Covered

panels.description: internet_https (generate_204) reachability of the weakest room, on its recently-reported working band. max-by-room = a room is OK if EITHER band reached the internet (avoids a false FAIL from the stale off-band); outer min = FAIL only if some room has no working band. probe_success is freshness-gated (changes(uptime)>0) so a dead probe's cache-frozen success can't show green.

targets.expr: min(max by (room) (probe_success{job="wifi-probe", probe="internet_https", room=~"$room", band=~"$band"} and on (instance) (changes(wifi_probe_uptime_seconds{job="wifi-probe"}[$window]) > 0)))

panels.title: 🌐 Worst-Room Internet

panels.description: Most negative connected-link RSSI across selected rooms/bands.
panels.title: 📶 Weakest Link RSSI

panels.description: Unexpected WiFi disconnects over $window. Excludes the ~once-per-cycle band-switch flaps, so a healthy probe sits at 0.
panels.title: 🔌 Disconnects ($window)

panels.description: Smallest largest-contiguous free block among selected probes — the real OOM predictor (what the HeapLow alert fires on, <32768). A big total heap can still OOM if it's fragmented.
panels.title: 🧠 Min Contiguous Heap

panels.description: Oldest probe last-success age. NOTE: a never-succeeded probe emits no age series; pair with Probes Failing. Frozen at last push for a dead probe — read with Per-room push freshness.
panels.title: ⏱️ Max Probe Staleness

panels.description: Count of room×probe×band checks that are failing OR stale: an explicit last-attempt failure (success==0 on a fresh probe) OR a probe whose uptime hasn't advanced within $window (cache-frozen, counted as failing so a dead probe frozen at success=1 can't read green). or vector(0) keeps a healthy 0 green.

targets.expr: count((probe_success{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room", band=~"$band"} == 0 and on (instance) (changes(wifi_probe_uptime_seconds{job="wifi-probe"}[$window]) > 0)) or (probe_success{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room", band=~"$band"} unless on (instance) (changes(wifi_probe_uptime_seconds{job="wifi-probe"}[$window]) > 0))) or vector(0)

panels.title: ❌ Probes Failing
🎯 Probe Results — reachability SLA (per room × probe)

panels.description: Share of room×probe×band checks whose last attempt succeeded. A fraction (not a raw count) so the verdict stays correct when you filter $room or $band. Numerator is freshness-gated (changes(uptime)>0) — a cache-frozen dead probe drops out of the numerator but stays in the full denominator, so it drags the verdict down instead of falsely passing.

targets.expr: sum(probe_success{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room", band=~"$band"} and on (instance) (changes(wifi_probe_uptime_seconds{job="wifi-probe"}[$window]) > 0)) / count(probe_success{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room", band=~"$band"})

panels.title: ✅ Checks passing %

panels.description: Single worst room×probe success ratio over $window. clamp_min avoids 0/0; prefer $window ≥15m.

targets.expr: min(sum(increase(probe_success_total{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room", band=~"$band"}[$window])) by (room, probe) / clamp_min(sum(increase(probe_attempts_total{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room", band=~"$band"}[$window])) by (room, probe), 1))

panels.title: 📉 Worst success ratio

panels.description: Oldest last-success across room×probe. Never-succeeded probes are omitted here — see the matrix. Frozen at last push for a dead probe — read with Per-room push freshness.
panels.title: ⏱️ Stalest probe age

panels.description: Worst non-zero internet_https code. 204 = clean internet; 200/302 = captive portal / DNS hijack; 0 = timeout. != 0 drops timeout zeros so a concurrent band timeout can't mask a captive-portal 200/302; or vector(0) shows a clean 0 (timeout) when every band is timing out.
panels.title: 🌐 HTTPS status (204?)

panels.description: THE core SLA view: OK/FAIL lane per room×probe×band over time. spanNulls holds value across the off-band phase. Per-band lanes expose a band-specific dead spot.
panels.title: 🎯 Probe success matrix — room × probe × band

panels.description: Δsuccess/Δattempts over $window, bands merged per room×probe. Generous window smooths the per-cycle quantization; clamp_min avoids 0/0 gaps.

targets.expr: sum(increase(probe_success_total{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room", band=~"$band"}[$window])) by (room, probe) / clamp_min(sum(increase(probe_attempts_total{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room", band=~"$band"}[$window])) by (room, probe), 1)

panels.title: Success ratio over $window (room × probe)

panels.description: Real request latency per room×probe×band: TTFB for the HTTPS probe (its total is ~95% fixed TLS-handshake crypto on the MCU, not network), total duration for ICMP/DNS (no handshake → total IS the RTT). Coarse staircase (one step/cycle); held segments are normal. The HTTPS handshake cost lives in the next panel so it doesn't false-red here.

targets.expr: (probe_last_duration_seconds{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room", band=~"$band", type!="http"} or probe_http_ttfb_seconds{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room", band=~"$band"} or (probe_last_duration_seconds{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room", band=~"$band", type="http"} unless on (room, instance, probe, band, target) probe_http_ttfb_seconds{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room", band=~"$band"}))

panels.title: 📨 Request latency — TTFB (HTTPS) / RTT

panels.description: Windowed mean of the real request latency (TTFB for HTTPS, total for ICMP/DNS), bands merged per room×probe. avg_over_time over a subquery smooths the per-cycle quantization.

targets.expr: avg by (room, probe) (avg_over_time((probe_last_duration_seconds{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room", band=~"$band", type!="http"} or probe_http_ttfb_seconds{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room", band=~"$band"} or (probe_last_duration_seconds{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room", band=~"$band", type="http"} unless on (room, instance, probe, band, target) probe_http_ttfb_seconds{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room", band=~"$band"}))[$window:1m]))

panels.title: Avg request latency over $window

panels.description: Splits the HTTPS probe: connect = DNS+TCP+TLS handshake (the ~0.7 s fixed TLS-crypto cost on the C5 MCU — NOT network, ~10-20× a real CPU), TTFB = the real request round-trip (~20 ms, matches curl). A connect spike (esp. with err_stage=tls / err_esp=0x8017) = a TLS regression like the 0.9.1 heap-OOM TLS failure; TTFB is the real internet-latency signal. No threshold colouring — the ~0.7 s connect is expected here.
panels.title: 🌐 HTTPS handshake vs TTFB (internet_https)

panels.description: internet_https code per room/band — a flip 204→200/302 marks a captive portal; 0 marks a hard timeout.
panels.title: HTTPS status code over time

panels.description: histogram_quantile p95 of probe_duration_seconds for the round-trip probes (gateway / internet_ip / lan_dns), per room×probe. HTTPS is EXCLUDED — its total is TLS-handshake-dominated; use the TTFB / handshake panels for HTTPS. NOTE: the histogram observes ALL attempts incl. failures at full duration, so a p95 spike can be failures — cross-check the success matrix.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, room, probe) (rate(probe_duration_seconds_bucket{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room", band=~"$band", type!="http"}[$window])))

panels.title: p95 latency over $window (ICMP/DNS)

panels.description: Dense per-(room,probe,band) sheet joining every probe metric. A blank Success-age next to Up=0 is the silently-failing / never-succeeded signature. target column confirms each probe is aimed correctly. Last/Avg = real request latency (TTFB for HTTPS, total for ICMP/DNS).

targets.expr: sum(increase(probe_success_total{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room", band=~"$band"}[$window])) by (room, probe, band, target, type, instance) / clamp_min(sum(increase(probe_attempts_total{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room", band=~"$band"}[$window])) by (room, probe, band, target, type, instance), 1)

(probe_last_duration_seconds{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room", band=~"$band", type!="http"} or probe_http_ttfb_seconds{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room", band=~"$band"} or (probe_last_duration_seconds{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room", band=~"$band", type="http"} unless on (room, instance, probe, band, target) probe_http_ttfb_seconds{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room", band=~"$band"}))

avg by (room, probe, band, target, type, instance) (avg_over_time((probe_last_duration_seconds{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room", band=~"$band", type!="http"} or probe_http_ttfb_seconds{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room", band=~"$band"} or (probe_last_duration_seconds{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room", band=~"$band", type="http"} unless on (room, instance, probe, band, target) probe_http_ttfb_seconds{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room", band=~"$band"}))[$window:1m]))

panels.title: 📋 Probe SLA matrix — room × probe × band

panels.description: Ranks every room×probe by staleness. CAVEAT: a never-succeeded probe shows NO bar — cross-check the success matrix (always has a lane). Frozen at last push for a dead probe — read with Per-room push freshness.
panels.title: Probe freshness — last-success age

panels.description: Last error stage per room×probe×band over time (the WifiProbeInternetDown alert points here): 0 ok · 1 dns · 2 tcp · 3 tls · 4 http · 5 timeout · 6 internal. A sustained tls/timeout lane pins the failing stage of a down probe.
panels.title: 🚦 Probe error stage

panels.description: increase() of probe_errors_total bucketed by failing stage over $window, summed per room×probe×stage. Stacked so the dominant failure mode (dns / tcp / tls / http / timeout) for a flaky probe is obvious.

targets.expr: sum by (room, probe, stage) (increase(probe_errors_total{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room", band=~"$band"}[$window]))

panels.title: 📊 Errors by stage / $window
📶 WiFi Link Quality — RSSI / channel / BSSID

panels.description: Sparse staircase: each band refreshes ~once/cycle and is absent during the other band's phase. stepBefore + spanNulls hold the last value; points mark real samples.
panels.title: RSSI by room & band

panels.description: last_over_time over $window so a band that's briefly off-air keeps its last reading instead of dropping out.
panels.title: Current RSSI per room (band-split)

panels.description: RSSI + channel + BSSID/SSID/auth per room×band. group_left carries the AP labels onto each value so the frames share one label set; last_over_time keeps a briefly off-air band populated.

targets.expr: last_over_time(wifi_client_rssi_dbm{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room", band=~"$band"}[$window]) * on (instance, band) group_left(bssid, ssid, auth) last_over_time(wifi_client_bssid_info{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room", band=~"$band"}[$window])

last_over_time(wifi_client_channel{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room", band=~"$band"}[$window]) * on (instance, band) group_left(bssid, ssid, auth) last_over_time(wifi_client_bssid_info{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room", band=~"$band"}[$window])

panels.title: Current link detail per room

panels.description: Channel as labeled segments per room/band — spot 5g DFS moves or 2g 1/6/11 hops.
panels.title: Link channel over time (roams)

panels.description: One row per probe: build_info labels (incl. firmware self-reported location) joined with uptime, free heap, and live connected flag. Compare `Self-reported room` to `Room` (scrape label) to confirm a probe is physically where its target claims.

targets.expr: max by (room, instance) (wifi_probe_uptime_seconds{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room"}) * on (instance) group_left(version, idf, chip, location) topk(1, wifi_probe_build_info{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room"}) by (instance)

max by (room, instance) (wifi_probe_heap_free_bytes{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room"}) * on (instance) group_left(version, idf, chip, location) topk(1, wifi_probe_build_info{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room"}) by (instance)

max by (room, instance) (wifi_client_connected{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room"}) * on (instance) group_left(version, idf, chip, location) topk(1, wifi_probe_build_info{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room"}) by (instance)

panels.title: 🏷️ Probe identity & build — per room

panels.description: Sawtooth that drops to ~0 marks a reboot/crash. Device-level (not band-gated).
panels.title: ⏱️ Uptime since boot — per room

panels.description: Downward drift over hours = leak → predicts an OOM reboot. min-free is the firmware's since-boot low-water mark; largest-block is the biggest contiguous free block (the real OOM predictor — a high free total can still OOM if fragmented).
panels.title: 🧠 Free heap — leak watch

panels.description: Unexpected-disconnect increase() over the generous $window (excludes the once-per-cycle band-switch flaps, so a healthy probe stays flat at 0). No band label on this counter.
panels.title: 🔌 Disconnects — increase/$window

panels.description: One lane per room. max by(room,instance) suppresses cosmetic single-scrape dips on band switch; a sustained red band is a real outage.
panels.title: 📶 Connected state — band-switch flaps

panels.description: Passive-scan AP list per room×band×BSSID, enriched with the operator-assigned name (wifi_ap_info, set via PATCH /aps — blank if the BSSID isn't named). The same BSSID at different RSSI from different rooms is your coverage map. Top ~6 APs per band; an empty table = scan not yet populated for that band.

targets.expr: wifi_ap_info{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room"} and on (bssid, instance) wifi_ap_rssi_dbm{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room", band=~"$band"}

panels.title: 📡 Surveyed APs per room (RSSI desc)

panels.description: Strongest AP each room can hear, per band — the single-number coverage verdict. A red bar flags a dead-spot room; an absent bar = no AP heard on that band.
panels.title: Best AP RSSI per room (strongest seen)

panels.description: Coverage drift / interference fades. Stair-stepped due to per-cycle scan refresh; do not rate()-smooth a gauge.
panels.title: Best AP RSSI per room — trend

panels.description: Co-channel congestion: distinct APs seen per channel/band, as seen by the selected room(s), not the whole airspace. Inner max-by dedupes a BSSID seen from several rooms. LOWER is better (opposite polarity to RSSI). Undercounts (top-6 cap).

targets.expr: count by (channel, band) (max by (channel, band, bssid) (wifi_ap_rssi_dbm{job="wifi-probe", room=~"$room", band=~"$band"}))

panels.title: Channel occupancy — distinct BSSIDs/channel

panels.description: Distinct radios (BSSIDs), networks (SSIDs), and channels in the current room/band scan — as seen by the selected room(s), not the whole airspace.
panels.title: 📻 Airspace inventory
📡 AP Survey — what each room sees (passive scan)

panels.description: otel-collector scrape target up. DOWN = the whole push pipeline is blind (no room reports). Pairs with the OtelCollectorDown alert.
panels.title: 🔌 Collector

panels.description: Collector resident memory. metric_expiration (30m) bounds the held series; watch for unbounded growth.
panels.title: 🧠 Collector RAM

panels.description: Receiver-refused datapoints/s — should be 0. Nonzero = malformed pushes or backpressure.
panels.title: 📥 Refused pts/s

panels.description: Exporter send-failed datapoints/s — should be 0. Nonzero = the :8889 Prometheus exporter is unhealthy.
panels.title: 📤 Send-fail pts/s

panels.description: Datapoints/s the collector accepts from probe pushes (and re-exports to Prometheus). Each room pushes ~7 chunks per ~50-110s band cycle; a room going silent steps this down.
panels.title: 📈 Ingest throughput — accepted vs exported pts/s

panels.description: Per room: 1 = a push advanced uptime within the last 6m (PUSHING), 0 = STALE. The direct per-room liveness signal now that `up` reflects the collector, not each probe. 6m > one band cycle so a healthy room never flaps.
panels.title: 🟢 Per-room push freshness
🔌 OTLP Push Pipeline — collector & per-room freshness
